task: Ship the ADO built-in work-item field name table as a Skill (paired with the existing ADO work-item toolkit) instead of pasting it into the system prompt.

key_reasoning.reason: Two real design gaps are open, not just minor confirmations: (1) the ticket's authoritative field list comes from an external Microsoft Learn page that could not be fetched during research, so the exact content is unsourced; (2) the 'tools and skill must be provided together' requirement has no existing toolkit→skill enforcement mechanism in the codebase (only skill→toolkit exists via Skill.toolkits) — whether this is enforced in code or left as documentation is an unmade decision that carries rework risk.

Deliverable is a single new preconfigured-skill template (config/templates/skill/) following an established 7-template pattern and the unmodified Skill→SkillTool runtime path; no new tool or toolkit code is required for the core ask.

Closest existing pattern is the 7 existing YAML skill templates seeded via manage_preconfigured_skills() — a mature, well-tested mechanism. Content-only change, no auth/authz, no performance-critical path, easy rollback (revert the template file).
